$comment: Coverage thresholds for Hermes Launchpad. Source of truth for enforcement command. Thresholds: 33/47/26/33 (current achievable baseline, pre-campaign). 100% is the campaign target; update per WU as coverage grows.

enforcement.description: Hermes Launchpad agents MUST verify coverage meets these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails. Target: 100% all metrics (ramp per WU).
